title: Customers
description: Everyone who has talked to you, on whichever channel they used.
unavailable: We couldn't read your customers just now.

lookedAt.name: We looked at names. Order numbers aren't searchable — orders don't live in GOTCHA.
lookedAt.phone: We looked at phone numbers. Order numbers aren't searchable — orders don't live in GOTCHA.
lookedAt.email: We looked at email addresses. Order numbers aren't searchable — orders don't live in GOTCHA.

list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No one yet} =1 {One person} other {# people}}
list.none: Nobody has talked to you yet.
list.unnamed: No name or handle on this contact
list.truncated: Showing the first {shown} records. There are {total} in all, and some may turn out to be the same person.

identityLimit: If the same person writes from WhatsApp and from Instagram, they appear here twice. GOTCHA joins two entries only when it has the same phone number for both — and Instagram never provides one.

brief.none: There's no written summary for this person yet. GOTCHA writes one when a conversation ends.
brief.noConversations: No written summary — there are no conversations with this person to write one from.

memory.heading: What GOTCHA remembers
memory.noPerFactTrace: GOTCHA records which conversation each of these came from, but those conversations can't be opened from here yet — so there's nothing to follow. They also can't be corrected or removed from here.
memory.none: GOTCHA hasn't learned anything durable about this person yet.
memory.unavailable: We couldn't read what GOTCHA remembers about this person.

timeline.heading: Recent activity
timeline.everyChannel: Every channel this person reaches you on, in one stream — including numbers and handles that were merged into them.
timeline.empty: Nothing recorded with this person yet.
timeline.partial: Showing {shown, number} of {total, number} messages with this person.
timeline.whole: {total, plural, one {# message} other {All {total, number} messages}} with this person.
timeline.scanTruncated: This person has more conversations than we scan in one go, so the oldest may not be represented here.

absent.money: Spend, order count and refunds aren't shown here. Reading them means calling your store live for each customer, so they appear where one person is being decided about — on an approval — rather than on every page.

detail.neverWritten: This person has never written to you. There's nothing to summarise, no conversation history, no orders and no notes — not because anything failed, but because nothing has happened yet.

notes.heading: Notes
notes.noCrm: Notes are kept in your CRM, and there isn't one connected. Connect one in Business core and notes about your customers will appear here.
notes.noLink: You have a CRM connected, but this person isn't linked to a record in it — so there's nowhere for their notes to live yet.
notes.empty: No notes on this person in your CRM.
notes.unavailable: We couldn't read notes from your CRM.
notes.anonymous: Your CRM doesn't record who wrote a note, so these show a date and no author.
notes.readOnly: Notes are read here and written in your CRM. Writing one from this page would file it against the wrong conversation, so it isn't offered yet.

orders.heading: Orders
orders.unread: We couldn't read this customer's orders.

state.not_connected: No store is connected, so there are no orders to show. Connect one in Business core.
state.connection_unhealthy: Your store is connected and not working, so orders can't be read right now. Fix it in Business core rather than connecting it again.
state.customer_not_linked: Your store has no customer record matching this person, so there are no orders to show against them.
state.verification_required: This person hasn't been verified as the owner of this account, so their orders aren't shown.
state.no_orders: No orders from this person yet.
state.unavailable: Orders couldn't be loaded just now. This usually passes — try again in a moment.

orders.missingScopes: Your store connection is working, but GOTCHA was never granted permission to read orders. Grant these in Shopify: {scopes}.
orders.moreItems: {count, plural, one {# more item} other {# more items}} on this order.
orders.refundableMax: Up to {amount} can still be refunded.
orders.pendingApproval: This is waiting for someone to approve it. It hasn't happened yet, and it hasn't failed — it's in your Approvals queue until a person decides.
orders.denied: This wasn't allowed: {reason}. Nothing was changed.
orders.actionUnavailable: This couldn't be done just now: {reason}. Nothing was changed.
orders.outcomeUnknown: We don't know whether that went through. Please do NOT try it again — check the order in your store first, and contact us if it looks wrong.
orders.noConversationToActThrough: These orders can't be acted on from here — there's no conversation with this person to carry the action.
